meta.title: Pune infrastructure ground-truth facts (VirtualPlanner / UrbanOS)

confidence_levels.official: stated by the responsible agency or Parliament on its own site; no other official value competes
confidence_levels.official_conflicting: two official sources disagree; the primary value is the newest official statement and alt_values holds the other official value(s)
confidence_levels.slipped: an official planned date that has passed and was replaced by a later official date (none in this version)

meta.method: Every quote was checked programmatically against the text of the page as fetched on the retrieval date (quote_verified). Quotes of type 'table_row' are cells of a PDF table joined by '|', not a prose sentence. as_of is the date the value was true per the source; null where the source gives no date (use publish date).
meta.official_rule: Only values stated by the responsible agency or Parliament on its own site (gov.in, nic.in, punemetrorail.org, mahametro.org, sansad.in, msrdc.in; backend/updater/official.py) are in this file. News reports are not: their values are recorded only in PUNE_PROJECT_FACTS.md, section 'Not in the dataset: unofficial reports'.
meta.history: v1 (2026-11-21, branch pune-facts b2eb8e8): 180 records from official and news sources. v2 (2026-11-21): official-only rule; 108 records kept with official sources only, 7 attributes with no official figure listed in not_available, the rest moved to PUNE_PROJECT_FACTS.md.
